text:
mark: Heads-up: Praxis Health sent an RFI. They want a completed capability matrix, full security questionnaire, POC plan, and ballpark pricing for a 3-month pilot by EOD Friday. Who can take what?
jen: Ill own pricing + SOW. Need guidance on Dedicated commit tiers and burst pricing.
samir: I can draft the POC plan and perf tests. When can infra provision a slot?
mark: Security questions include BYOK/HSM, key custody, SOC/FedRAMP posture, and audit retention. Ellie, can you take the security answers or should I loop SecOps?
ellie: Ill do it but need specifics for Private (VPC peering, on-prem HSM flow) and a short network diagram. Also need standard verbiage for audit log retention.
sec-bot: Compliance pack v3.1 available: https://drive.redwood/compliance/packs/security-compliance-v3.1.zip (last updated 2025-01-12).
jen: For pricing: Praxis expects sustained ~200 req/s. What Dedicated commit + GPU mix do we recommend? Need quick CPU/GPU cost split.
samir: For the POC: request 2x a100-equivalent nodes for 2 weeks, run a 5k prompt perf suite (seq_len=512), measure p50/p95 token latency and throughput, 3 iterations across 24h. Ops: can you provision by Wed?
ellie: Praxis requires BYOK for PHI. Our options: customer-managed KMS for Hosted (AES envelope), and HSM-backed keys for Private deployments. Ill include enrollment steps and a KMS/HSM checklist.
mark: Note: quantized (4-bit) model support is in evaluation for some model families; not GA for all. Call out fallback to float model with auto-routing if quality fails.
jen: Ill produce two pricing scenarios: hosted (per-token + overage) and Dedicated reserve with burst. Draft numbers by tomorrow AM.
samir: Quick perf plan snippet to include in packet: ```- 2 nodes (a100) dedicated
- 5k synthetic prompts, seq_len=512
- measure p50/p95 token latency and throughput
- 3 runs staggered over 24h```
ellie: I'll attach KMS/HSM checklist and a simple VPC peering diagram. Anyone have a peering template?
mark: Ill ping eng-infra for provisioning and book a 1-hr runbook call tomorrow 10am PT. Samir, include runbook steps for model fallback.
samir: Yes  will add model-version fallback + expected metrics for failing quality checks.
ellie: Add audit logging requirement: fallback events logged with timestamp, model version, request id, and failure reason.
jen: For the capability matrix I need exact wording for: model version pinning, canary rollouts, token-level billing export, and embeddings throughput. Samir: Pinning = customer sets a model version tag; traffic routes to it until changed. Canary = console supports %-based routing.
mark: Important blocker to surface: on-prem HSM is only available for Private deployments; hosted API supports BYOK via customer KMS only. Be explicit.
ellie: Will include: "On-prem HSM supported only for Private deployments; hosted API supports KMS BYOK."
jen: Ill upload the capability matrix, pricing, and SOW to Drive by 9am tomorrow and link in the packet.
samir: I have a token-cost CSV template. Will sanitize and drop it into the Drive.
ellie: Ill add PHI handling notes and recommended redaction steps to the appendix.
mark: Recap action items: Jen = pricing + packet; Ellie = security answers + network diag; Samir = POC perf plan + runbook; Mark = legal + infra booking. Sec-bot: please repost compliance pack link when the packet is attached.
sec-bot: Compliance pack link: https://drive.redwood/compliance/packs/security-compliance-v3.1.zip
jen: Any last asks from Praxis we should preempt? They mentioned auditing + export for token-level billing and a sample SLA.
mark: Escalate feature gaps to prod@redwood. Aim to deliver complete packet Friday morning. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
